newsitem.title: USA: Metro Networks sets IPO terms at about $100 mln.
newsitem.headline: Metro Networks sets IPO terms at about $100 mln.

text.p: Metro Networks Inc has set terms for its initial public offering at about $100 million, according to a regulatory filing.

Goldman Sachs & Co is the lead underwriter of the offering of 7.2 million shares, which are due to price in a range of $13 to $15. Of the total shares, half will be offered by the company and half will be offered by selling stockholders.

The company, which is profitable, provides traffic reports, local news, sports, and weather to the television and radio broadcast industries. Metro Networks has filed to trade on the Nasdaq under the proposed symbol "MTNT".
